scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:unsandboxed: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:unsandboxed" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:duel
